description: AI On-call Runbook — Draft an SRE on-call runbook for a service or alert: service= (required), optional alert=, stack= and oncall=. Returns markdown with Overview, Severity (SEV1-3), Detection, Triage, Diagnosis, Mitigation, Escalation, Verification and Follow-up, plus parsed sections, numbered-step count, risky-step warnings and missing-section check. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).
